description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView that implements the LogNode interface for logging purposes. It is used to display log messages on the UI, formatting log data including priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and chaining to other LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView used to output log data received through the LogNode interface, with capabilities to format and display log entries and chain to other LogNodes.

methods.name: LogView(Context)
methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a Context.

methods.name: LogView(Context, AttributeSet)
methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a Context and XML attributes.

methods.name: LogView(Context, AttributeSet, int)
methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a Context, XML attributes, and style.

methods.name: println(int, String, String, Throwable)
methods.description: Formats and outputs log data, then displays it on the LogView and forwards it to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog(String)
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line of log data to the LogView.
